      '<div class="stat"><div class="v">' + b.toFixed(3) + '</div><div class="k">Spearman, B5 + OPEN<sub>home</sub></div></div>' +
      '<div class="stat"><div class="v">' + worse + '</div><div class="k">where OPEN moved the forecast away</div></div>';
    const fp = COH.frozen_prediction;
    $('#t-browser').textContent = 'Across the ' + full.length + ' concepts in view with an outcome, the B5 forecast ranks observed breadth at Spearman ' + a.toFixed(3) + ' and adding OPEN_home gives ' + b.toFixed(3) + ' (' + f(b - a) + '). On all ' + fp.n + ' concepts the recorded gain is ' + f(fp.diff) + ' ' + fci(fp.diff_ci) + ': openness barely moves individual forecasts.';
  } else {
    st.innerHTML = '<div class="stat"><div class="v">' + full.length + '</div><div class="k">concepts with outcome and both forecasts</div></div>';
    $('#t-browser').textContent = 'Fewer than three concepts in view have an outcome and both forecasts, so no rank correlation is computed. Widen the filter.';
  }

}
function drawDetail(){

    '<p style="margin:6px 0 0">OPEN<sub>home</sub> ' + (r.open_home === null ? 'n/a (fewer than 10 home papers or 4 components)' : f(r.open_home)) + '; OPEN<sub>all</sub> ' + (r.open_all === null ? 'n/a' : f(r.open_all)) + '; OPEN<sub>sizematch</sub> ' + (r.open_size === null ? 'n/a' : f(r.open_size)) + '</p></div>' +

    '<p style="margin:0">Method, B5 + OPEN<sub>home</sub> forecast: <strong>' + (r.pB5O === null ? 'n/a' : r.pB5O.toFixed(2)) + '</strong>' + err(r.pB5O) + '</p>' +

function drawLine(r){
  const svg = $('#s-line'); if (!svg) return; const div = svg.parentNode; const W = Math.max(220, div.clientWidth); const H = 92; svg.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 ' + W + ' ' + H); svg.setAttribute('height', H);
  const pts = [{k: 'B5 forecast', v: r.pB5, c: C.muted, y: 20}, {k: 'B5 + OPEN forecast', v: r.pB5O, c: C.accent, y: 34}, {k: 'Observed', v: r.obs, c: C.warn, y: 48}].filter(p => p.v !== null);
  if (!pts.length){ txt(svg, 4, 40, 'No forecast or outcome recorded for this concept.', {'font-size': 12}); return; }
  const hi = Math.max(15, ...pts.map(p => p.v)); const x0 = 10, x1 = W - 10; const X = v => x0 + v / hi * (x1 - x0);
  const tk = niceTicks(0, hi, Math.max(2, Math.floor(W / 60)));
  tk.forEach(t => { el('line', {x1: X(t), x2: X(t), y1: 10, y2: 58, stroke: C.grid}, svg); txt(svg, X(t), 72, String(t), {'text-anchor': 'middle', 'font-size': 11}); });
  txt(svg, (x0 + x1) / 2, 88, 'Rarefied breadth (venue fields in 50 papers)', {'text-anchor': 'middle', 'font-size': 12, 'font-weight': 600});
  pts.forEach(p => { const g = el('g', {class: 'mark', tabindex: 0, role: 'img', 'aria-label': p.k + ': ' + p.v.toFixed(2)}, svg);
    el('rect', {class: 'hit', x: X(p.v) - 8, y: p.y - 8, width: 16, height: 16, fill: 'transparent', rx: 3}, g);
    el('circle', {cx: X(p.v), cy: p.y, r: 6, fill: p.c}, g); bindMark(g, div, '<b>' + p.k + '</b>' + p.v.toFixed(2) + ' fields'); });
}
let scatterPts = [], scatterFocus = -1;
function drawScatter(){
  const svg = $('#s-scatter'), div = svg.parentNode; svg.innerHTML = '';
  const W = Math.max(280, div.clientWidth), fs = W < 480 ? 11 : 12; const H = Math.min(380, Math.max(260, W * 0.6));
  const all = REC.filter(r => r.full), inView = new Set(view.filter(r => r.full));
  const xs = all.map(r => r.open_home), ys = all.map(r => r.excess);
  let xlo = Math.min(...xs), xhi = Math.max(...xs), ylo = Math.min(...ys), yhi = Math.max(...ys);
  const xp = (xhi - xlo) * 0.04, yp = (yhi - ylo) * 0.05; xlo -= xp; xhi += xp; ylo -= yp; yhi += yp;
  const yt = niceTicks(ylo, yhi, 5), ystep = yt[1] - yt[0];
  const tickW = Math.max(...yt.map(t => measure(tickFmt(t, ystep), fs))); const left = 18 + 8 + tickW + 6, right = 10, top = 8, bottom = 42;
  svg.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 ' + W + ' ' + H); svg.setAttribute('height', H);
  const X = v => left + (v - xlo) / (xhi - xlo) * (W - left - right), Y = v => top + (yhi - v) / (yhi - ylo) * (H - top - bottom);
  const xt = niceTicks(xlo, xhi, Math.max(2, Math.floor((W - left) / 70))), xstep = xt[1] - xt[0];
  xt.forEach(t => { el('line', {x1: X(t), x2: X(t), y1: top, y2: H - bottom, stroke: C.grid}, svg); txt(svg, X(t), H - bottom + 15, tickFmt(t, xstep), {'text-anchor': 'middle', 'font-size': fs}); });
  yt.forEach(t => { el('line', {x1: left, x2: W - right, y1: Y(t), y2: Y(t), stroke: C.grid}, svg); txt(svg, left - 6, Y(t) + 4, tickFmt(t, ystep), {'text-anchor': 'end', 'font-size': fs}); });
  el('line', {x1: left, x2: W - right, y1: Y(0), y2: Y(0), stroke: C.ink2, 'stroke-width': 1.2}, svg);
  txt(svg, (left + W - right) / 2, H - 6, 'OPEN_home (mean signed z, SD units)', {'text-anchor': 'middle', 'font-size': fs + 1, 'font-weight': 600});
  txt(svg, 14, (top + H - bottom) / 2, 'Observed minus B5 forecast (fields)', {'text-anchor': 'middle', 'font-size': fs + 1, 'font-weight': 600, transform: 'rotate(-90 14 ' + ((top + H - bottom) / 2) + ')'});
  const g = el('g', {}, svg);
  scatterPts = [];
  all.forEach(r => { const on = inView.has(r); const c = el('circle', {cx: X(r.open_home), cy: Y(r.excess), r: on ? 3.2 : 2.4, fill: on ? C.accent : '#c9ced4', 'fill-opacity': on ? 0.55 : 0.5, style: 'cursor:pointer'}, g);
    if (on) scatterPts.push({r: r, x: X(r.open_home), y: Y(r.excess)});
    c.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => scTip(r, X(r.open_home), Y(r.excess))); c.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { div.querySelector('.tip').style.display = 'none'; });
    c.addEventListener('click', e => { e.stopPropagation(); selectFromScatter(r); scTip(r, X(r.open_home), Y(r.excess)); }); });
  scatterPts.sort((a, b) => a.x - b.x);
  if (selected && selected.full){ el('circle', {cx: X(selected.open_home), cy: Y(selected.excess), r: 7, fill: C.warn, stroke: '#fff', 'stroke-width': 2}, svg); }
  svg.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Scatter plot of ' + scatterPts.length + ' concepts in view. Use left and right arrow keys to move between concepts in order of openness; Enter selects.');
}
function scTip(r, x, y){ const div = $('#c-scatter'), tip = div.querySelector('.tip'); tip.innerHTML = '<b>' + esc(r.name) + '</b>OPEN<sub>home</sub> ' + f(r.open_home) + '<br>Observed ' + r.obs.toFixed(2) + ', B5 forecast ' + r.pB5.toFixed(2) + '<br>Beyond forecast ' + f(r.excess, 2) + ' fields';
  tip.style.display = 'block'; const w = div.clientWidth; tip.style.left = Math.max(0, Math.min(x - tip.offsetWidth / 2, w - tip.offsetWidth)) + 'px'; tip.style.top = Math.max(0, y - tip.offsetHeight - 10) + 'px'; }
function selectFromScatter(r){ selected = r; const i = view.indexOf(r); if (i >= shown) shown = Math.ceil((i + 1) / 50) * 50; drawBrowser(false); }
$('#s-scatter').addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (!scatterPts.length) return;
  if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft'){ e.preventDefault(); scatterFocus = scatterFocus < 0 ? 0 : Math.max(0, Math.min(scatterPts.length - 1, scatterFocus + (e.key === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : -1))); const p = scatterPts[scatterFocus]; scTip(p.r, p.x, p.y); }
  else if (e.key === 'Enter' && scatterFocus >= 0){ e.preventDefault(); selectFromScatter(scatterPts[scatterFocus].r); }
  else if (e.key === 'Escape'){ $('#c-scatter .tip').style.display = 'none'; }
});
$('#s-scatter').addEventListener('blur', () => { $('#c-scatter .tip').style.display = 'none'; });
['#b-search'].forEach(s => $(s).addEventListener('input', () => drawBrowser(true)));
['#b-group', '#b-scope', '#b-sort', '#b-worse'].forEach(s => $(s).addEventListener('change', () => drawBrowser(true)));
$('#b-more').addEventListener('click', () => { shown += 50; drawBrowser(false); });

/* ---------- 4a. OPEN calculator ---------- */
const CASE_MEMBERS = []; CASES.pairs.forEach((p, i) => { ['HIGH_OPEN', 'LOW_OPEN'].forEach(role => CASE_MEMBERS.push({pair: i + 1, role: role, m: p.members[role]})); });
CASE_MEMBERS.forEach((c, i) => { const o = document.createElement('option'); o.value = i; o.textContent = c.m.name + ' (pair ' + c.pair + ', ' + (c.role === 'HIGH_OPEN' ? 'high' : 'low') + ' OPEN)'; $('#o-concept').appendChild(o); });
COMPS.forEach(([k]) => { const l = document.createElement('label'); l.className = 'chk'; l.innerHTML = '<input type="checkbox" checked value="' + k + '"> ' + COMP[k]; $('#o-comps').appendChild(l); });
function drawOpen(){
  const c = CASE_MEMBERS[Number($('#o-concept').value)], m = c.m, build = document.querySelector('input[name=build]:checked').value;
  const on = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#o-comps input')).filter(i => i.checked).map(i => i.value);
  let rows = '<caption class="sr-only">Component values, frozen constants and signed z-scores</caption><thead><tr><th>Component</th><th class="n">Raw value</th><th class="n">Frozen mean</th><th class="n">Frozen SD</th><th class="n">Sign</th><th class="n">Signed z</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
  const zs = [];
  COMPS.forEach(([k, s]) => { const z = zOf(m, build, k); const inc = on.includes(k); if (inc) zs.push(z);
    rows += '<tr' + (inc ? '' : ' style="color:var(--muted)"') + '><td>' + COMP[k] + (inc ? '' : ' (off)') + '</td><td class="n">' + m.components[build][k].toFixed(3) + '</td><td class="n">' + f(ZC[build][k].mean, 3, false) + '</td><td class="n">' + ZC[build][k].sd.toFixed(3) + '</td><td class="n">' + (s > 0 ? '+1' : MINUS + '1') + '</td><td class="n">' + f(z) + '</td></tr>'; });
  const val = zs.length >= 4 ? zs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / zs.length : null; const rec = m.OPEN[build];
  rows += '<tr><td><strong>OPEN (mean of ' + zs.length + ')</strong></td><td colspan="4"></td><td class="n"><strong>' + (val === null ? 'undefined' : f(val)) + '</strong></td></tr></tbody>';
  $('#o-table').innerHTML = rows;
  const cats = COMPS.map(([k]) => ({label: COMP[k] + (on.includes(k) ? '' : ' (off)'), values: {v: zOf(m, build, k)}}));
  hbars('s-open', cats, [{key: 'v', name: 'Signed z', color: C.accent}], {xTitle: 'Signed z-score (SD units)', domain: [-2, 2]});
  const bname = {home: 'home-only', all: 'all-papers', size: 'size-matched'}[build];
  let t;
  if (val === null) t = 'With only ' + zs.length + ' components the score is undefined: the frozen rule needs at least 4 of 6.';
  else if (zs.length === 6) t = m.name + '\'s ' + bname + ' OPEN computed here is ' + f(val) + ', which equals the recorded ' + f(rec) + (Math.abs(val - rec) < 1e-9 ? ' (difference below 10⁻⁹).' : ' (difference ' + (val - rec).toExponential(2) + ').');
  else { const top = COMPS.filter(([k]) => on.includes(k)).map(([k]) => ({k: k, z: zOf(m, build, k)})).sort((a, b) => Math.abs(b.z) - Math.abs(a.z))[0];
    t = 'With ' + zs.length + ' of 6 components, ' + m.name + '\'s ' + bname + ' OPEN is ' + f(val) + ' against ' + f(rec) + ' with all six; the largest remaining contribution is ' + COMP[top.k].toLowerCase() + ' (' + f(top.z) + ').'; }
  $('#t-open').textContent = t;
}
$('#o-concept').addEventListener('change', drawOpen); document.querySelectorAll('input[name=build]').forEach(i => i.addEventListener('change', drawOpen));
$('#o-comps').addEventListener('change', drawOpen);

/* ---------- 4b. what-if threshold ---------- */
const FULL = REC.filter(r => r.full); const sortedOpen = FULL.map(r => r.open_home).sort((a, b) => a - b);
function quantile(p){ const pos = (sortedOpen.length - 1) * p; const lo = Math.floor(pos), hi = Math.ceil(pos); return sortedOpen[lo] + (sortedOpen[hi] - sortedOpen[lo]) * (pos - lo); }
function drawWhatIf(){
  const p = Number($('#w-pct').value); const thr = quantile(p / 100); $('#w-out').textContent = p + 'th (OPEN ≥ ' + f(thr, 2) + ')';
  const above = FULL.filter(r => r.open_home >= thr), below = FULL.filter(r => r.open_home < thr);
  const mean = a => a.reduce((s, r) => s + r.excess, 0) / a.length; const share = a => a.filter(r => r.excess > 0).length / a.length;
  const ma = mean(above), mb = mean(below);
  const cats = [{label: 'Below threshold (n = ' + below.length + ')', values: {v: mb}, tips: {v: Math.round(share(below) * 100) + '% broader than forecast'}},
    {label: 'At or above (n = ' + above.length + ')', values: {v: ma}, tips: {v: Math.round(share(above) * 100) + '% broader than forecast'}}];
  hbars('s-whatif', cats, [{key: 'v', name: 'Mean observed minus B5 forecast', color: C.accent}], {xTitle: 'Mean breadth beyond the B5 forecast (fields)', domain: [-0.6, 0.6], fmt: v => f(v, 2)});
  $('#t-whatif').textContent = 'Split at the ' + p + 'th percentile, the ' + above.length + ' more open concepts land ' + f(ma, 2) + ' fields from their B5 forecast on average and the ' + below.length + ' less open ones ' + f(mb, 2) + ', a gap of ' + f(ma - mb, 2) + ' fields. ' + Math.round(share(above) * 100) + '% versus ' + Math.round(share(below) * 100) + '% end up broader than forecast.';
}
$('#w-pct').addEventListener('input', drawWhatIf);

/* ---------- 5. failures ---------- */
const NV = { NOVCHURN_raw: 'Raw NOVCHURN', NOVCHURN_rare10: 'Rarefied to 10 home papers/yr', NOVCHURN_chao: 'Chao bias-corrected', NOVCHURN_cfg: 'Configuration-null z-scores', NOVCHURN_exc: 'Excess over permutation null' };
function drawNoise(){
  const rows = NOISE.map(r => ({ label: NV[r.variant], est: r.psp, lo: r.ci[0], hi: r.ci[1], shape: 'circle', color: r.variant === 'NOVCHURN_exc' ? C.warn : r.variant === 'NOVCHURN_raw' ? '#111' : C.accent,
    valueText: f(r.psp) + ' ' + fci(r.ci), shortText: f(r.psp),
    tip: '<b>' + NV[r.variant] + '</b>' + f(r.psp) + ' ' + fci(r.ci) + '<br>n = ' + r.n.toLocaleString() + (r.retention !== null ? '<br>Retains ' + Math.round(r.retention * 100) + '% of the same-sample raw value (' + f(r.same_sample_raw) + ')' : '') }));
  forest('s-noise', rows, {xTitle: 'Pooled partial Spearman with rarefied breadth, R2', domain: [-0.05, 0.2]});
  const ex = NOISE.find(r => r.variant === 'NOVCHURN_exc'), r10 = NOISE.find(r => r.variant === 'NOVCHURN_rare10'), ch = NOISE.find(r => r.variant === 'NOVCHURN_chao');
  $('#t-noise').textContent = 'Controls for sample size keep most of the signal (rarefaction ' + Math.round(r10.retention * 100) + '%, Chao ' + Math.round(ch.retention * 100) + '%), but the excess over a within-concept year-permutation null falls to ' + f(ex.psp) + ': what predicts breadth is a static property of the home-topic partner mix, and that null is too unreliable to test temporal turnover.';
}
function drawEntry(){
  const E = ENTRY, showChk = $('#e-checks').checked;
  const rows = [{label: 'DEV (selection)', dim: true, color: C.muted, shape: 'circle', est: E.dev.est, lo: E.dev.ci[0], hi: E.dev.ci[1], valueText: E.dev.est.toFixed(3) + ' ' + fci(E.dev.ci, 3, false), shortText: E.dev.est.toFixed(3),
    tip: '<b>Development set</b>' + E.dev.est.toFixed(3) + ' ' + fci(E.dev.ci, 3, false) + '<br>LR (R3 vs R2) = ' + E.dev.LR.toFixed(1)}];
  E.units.forEach(u => rows.push({label: u.label, shape: 'circle', est: u.est, lo: u.ci[0], hi: u.ci[1], valueText: f(u.est, 3, false) + ' ' + fci(u.ci, 3, false), shortText: f(u.est, 3, false),
    tip: '<b>' + esc(u.label) + '</b>' + f(u.est, 3, false) + ' ' + fci(u.ci, 3, false) + '<br>n = ' + u.n.toLocaleString() + ' concepts, ' + u.events.toLocaleString() + ' entry events' + (u.unit === 'MATHDEC' ? '<br>Excluded as underpowered before the freeze' : '')}));
  rows.push({label: '2010–14 cohort', shape: 'circle', est: E.cohort.est, lo: E.cohort.ci[0], hi: E.cohort.ci[1], valueText: E.cohort.est.toFixed(3) + ' ' + fci(E.cohort.ci, 3, false), shortText: E.cohort.est.toFixed(3), tip: '<b>2010–14 onset cohort</b>' + E.cohort.est.toFixed(3) + ' ' + fci(E.cohort.ci, 3, false) + '<br>n = ' + E.cohort.n.toLocaleString() + ' concepts'});
  rows.push({label: 'Held-out pooled', bold: true, shape: 'circle', color: '#111', est: E.pooled.est, lo: E.pooled.ci[0], hi: E.pooled.ci[1], valueText: E.pooled.est.toFixed(3) + ' ' + fci(E.pooled.ci, 3, false), shortText: E.pooled.est.toFixed(3),
    tip: '<b>Held-out pooled fit</b>' + E.pooled.est.toFixed(3) + ' ' + fci(E.pooled.ci, 3, false) + '<br>' + E.pooled.n_concepts.toLocaleString() + ' concepts, ' + E.pooled.n_events.toLocaleString() + ' entries in ' + E.pooled.n_strata.toLocaleString() + ' strata; LR ' + E.pooled.LR.toFixed(1)});
  rows.push({label: 'DL over 4 groups', bold: true, shape: 'diamond', est: E.DL.est, lo: E.DL.ci[0], hi: E.DL.ci[1], valueText: E.DL.est.toFixed(3) + ' ' + fci(E.DL.ci, 3, false), shortText: E.DL.est.toFixed(3), tip: '<b>DerSimonian–Laird pool</b>' + E.DL.est.toFixed(3) + ' ' + fci(E.DL.ci, 3, false) + '<br>I² = ' + E.DL.I2.toFixed(2)});
  if (showChk){
    const vm = E.vol_matched;
    rows.push({sep: true, label: 'Volume-matched contrast', color: C.warn, shape: 'circle', est: vm.est, lo: vm.ci[0], hi: vm.ci[1], valueText: f(vm.est) + ' ' + fci(vm.ci), shortText: f(vm.est),
      tip: '<b>Volume-matched contrast (held-out)</b>Retained minus entered-but-not-retained fields in the same volume cell: ' + f(vm.est) + ' ' + fci(vm.ci) + '<br>Holm p = ' + vm.holm_p.toFixed(2) + '; DEV ' + f(vm.dev_est) + '. Pre-registered criterion 5 fails.'});
    rows.push({label: 'd0 under min-cond.-prob. proximity', color: C.warn, shape: 'circle', est: E.mincp.d0, valueText: f(E.mincp.d0) + ' (p = ' + E.mincp.p.toFixed(3) + ')', shortText: f(E.mincp.d0),
      tip: '<b>Alternative proximity</b>Replacing PMI with minimum conditional probability, held-out d0 = ' + f(E.mincp.d0) + ' (p = ' + E.mincp.p.toFixed(3) + '), while RCA density becomes strong (LR ' + Math.round(E.mincp.rca_LR) + ').'});
  }
  forest('s-entry', rows, {xTitle: 'd0: log-odds of entry per SD of retained-field relatedness', domain: [-0.15, 0.5]});
  const d = E.dose;
  $('#t-entry').textContent = showChk ? 'The two checks that decide the verdict both fail: the volume-matched contrast is ' + f(E.vol_matched.est) + ' ' + fci(E.vol_matched.ci) + ' and d0 reverses to ' + f(E.mincp.d0) + ' under the standard proximity. The dose response by retention age (' + d['2'].toFixed(3) + ' / ' + d['3'].toFixed(3) + ' / ' + d['4+'].toFixed(3) + ') is not monotone. Verdict: ' + E.verdict + '.'
    : 'On the independent frame d0 = ' + E.pooled.est.toFixed(3) + ' ' + fci(E.pooled.ci, 3, false) + ', positive in all three evaluable held-out groups and the cohort, with high heterogeneity (I² = ' + E.DL.I2.toFixed(2) + '). Tick the box to see why the frozen verdict is still PARTIAL.';
}
$('#e-checks').addEventListener('change', drawEntry);
function drawMiss(){
  const worse = FULL.filter(r => r.worse), better = FULL.filter(r => !r.worse);
  const delta = r => Math.abs(r.obs - r.pB5) - Math.abs(r.obs - r.pB5O);
  const meanAbs = a => a.reduce((s, r) => s + Math.abs(r.pB5O - r.pB5), 0) / a.length;
  $('#miss-text').innerHTML = 'For each cohort concept with an outcome, compare the B5 forecast with the B5 + OPEN<sub>home</sub> forecast. In <strong>' + worse.length + ' of ' + FULL.length + '</strong> concepts adding OPEN moved the forecast further from the breadth the concept actually reached.';
  const cats = [{label: 'OPEN moved it closer (n = ' + better.length + ')', values: {v: better.reduce((s, r) => s + delta(r), 0) / better.length}, tips: {v: 'Mean shift in forecast ' + meanAbs(better).toFixed(3) + ' fields'}},
    {label: 'OPEN moved it away (n = ' + worse.length + ')', values: {v: worse.reduce((s, r) => s + delta(r), 0) / worse.length}, tips: {v: 'Mean shift in forecast ' + meanAbs(worse).toFixed(3) + ' fields'}}];
  hbars('s-miss', cats, [{key: 'v', name: 'Mean reduction in absolute error', color: C.accent}], {xTitle: 'Mean reduction in absolute forecast error (fields)', fmt: v => f(v, 3)});
  const all = FULL.reduce((s, r) => s + delta(r), 0) / FULL.length;
  $('#t-miss').textContent = 'Averaged over all ' + FULL.length + ' concepts, adding OPEN changes the absolute error by ' + f(all, 3) + ' fields; forecasts move by a few hundredths of a field either way, which is why the recorded forecasting gain is ' + f(COH.frozen_prediction.diff) + '.';
}
$('#miss-go').addEventListener('click', () => { $('#b-worse').checked = true; $('#b-scope').value = 'full'; $('#b-group').value = 'all'; $('#b-search').value = ''; drawBrowser(true); document.getElementById('evidence').scrollIntoView({behavior: reduceMotion ? 'auto' : 'smooth'}); setTimeout(() => $('#b-worse').focus({preventScroll: true}), reduceMotion ? 0 : 400); });
// tabs
const tabs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#fail-tabs [role=tab]'));
function selectTab(t){ tabs.forEach(x => { const on = x === t; x.setAttribute('aria-selected', on); x.tabIndex = on ? 0 : -1; document.getElementById(x.getAttribute('aria-controls')).hidden = !on; }); drawFails(); }
tabs.forEach((t, i) => { t.addEventListener('click', () => selectTab(t)); t.addEventListener('keydown', e => { let j = null; if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') j = (i + 1) % tabs.length; if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') j = (i - 1 + tabs.length) % tabs.length; if (e.key === 'Home') j = 0; if (e.key === 'End') j = tabs.length - 1; if (j !== null){ e.preventDefault(); tabs[j].focus(); selectTab(tabs[j]); } }); });
function drawFails(){ if (!$('#p-noise').hidden) drawNoise(); if (!$('#p-entry').hidden) drawEntry(); if (!$('#p-miss').hidden) drawMiss(); }

/* ---------- glossary and term tooltips ---------- */
const GLOSS = {
  o2r: ['Rarefied field breadth (O2r)', 'The expected number of distinct venue fields among a fixed-size random draw of m papers (m = 50 unless stated) from a concept\'s publications in years t0+6 to t0+8, computed by exact hypergeometric rarefaction. Rarefaction separates size-adjusted breadth from sheer volume.'],
  b5: ['B5 popularity baseline', 'Five features computed over t0 to t0+2: log early volume, publication growth, non-home share, Shannon entropy and field reach. Every indicator must add information beyond these.'],
  open: ['OPEN index', 'The mean of six signed z-scored ego-network components from the early window (t0 to t0+2): new edge rate, communities reached, participation coefficient and novelty residual count positively; ego density and edge persistence count negatively. OPEN_home uses the home-field co-occurrence graph only, OPEN_all the corpus-wide graph, OPEN_sizematch corpus-wide papers subsampled to home counts.'],
  psp: ['Partial Spearman priority (PSP)', 'The Pearson correlation of rank-transformed indicator and outcome residuals, both residualised on the baseline covariates and control rungs. Inference uses 2,000 concept-level bootstrap resamples with refit.'],
  dl: ['DerSimonian–Laird pooling', 'A random-effects estimator that pools estimates across field groups or bodies, reported with the I² share of variation due to heterogeneity.'],
  nonsel: ['Non-selection bodies', 'The four held-out home groups (Physical Sciences, Life & Environment, Social Sciences, Math & Decision) and the 2010–14 and 2015–17 onset cohorts. The index was chosen on the DEV body, which is not pooled; all non-selection bodies except the 2015–17 cohort had outcomes read in earlier analyses.'],
  rung: ['Control ladder rung', 'A set of controls of increasing strictness. R0 controls for B5 and onset year; R2 controls for B5 plus onset year, contact reach, concept type, a generic-concept flag and concept level; R3 adds the pre-onset footprint.'],
  ego: ['Ego network', 'A concept\'s topic co-occurrence neighbourhood: the nodes are the concept\'s positive-PMI neighbour topics (the concept itself is not drawn) and the edges are links between those topics in the topic backbone.'],
  leiden: ['Leiden community', 'A group of topics found by Leiden clustering of the topic backbone, named by the plurality OpenAlex field of its topics.'],
  t0: ['Onset year (t0)', 'The first year a concept reaches 20 grounded publications.'],
  home: ['Home field', 'The field or fields holding at least 40% of a concept\'s first 30 grounded papers.'],
  z: ['Frozen z-score', 'A component minus its mean, divided by its standard deviation, with both constants computed once on the 12,499-concept frame before any confirmation body was scored.'],
  novchurn: ['NOVCHURN', 'The mean of z(NOV_res) and −z(edge persistence): a two-component novelty and churn measure used in the mechanism analyses.'],
  retain: ['Retaining field', 'A field is retaining a concept when it has published at least two grounded papers on the concept in each of the two most recent years.'],

The panel split assigns these to a development set (DEV 4,771), four held-out domain groups (3,372) and a 2010–2014 onset cohort (4,356); a fresh 2015–2017 cohort (1,443) comes from a separate scan. 53 early indicators in six families are computed in the t<sub>0</sub> to t<sub>0</sub>+2 window, screened on DEV and validated on held-out groups (RQ1). Separately, a conditional-logit entry model is fitted on an independent frame of 11,841 concepts (RQ2).</figcaption>\n  </figure>\n  <div class=\"card\" id=\"stepper\" aria-labelledby=\"h-step\">\n    <h3 id=\"h-step\" style=\"margin-top:0\">One concept through the pipeline</h3>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-pipe\"><svg id=\"s-pipe\" role=\"img\" aria-label=\"Pipeline diagram with six stages; the current stage is highlighted\"></svg></div>\n    <ol class=\"steps\" id=\"step-markers\" aria-label=\"Stages\"></ol>\n    <p class=\"sr-only\" id=\"step-live\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    <div id=\"step-body\"></div>\n    <div class=\"stepnav\">\n      <button class=\"btn\" id=\"step-prev\" type=\"button\">Previous stage</button>\n      <button class=\"btn\" id=\"step-next\" type=\"button\">Next stage</button>\n      <span class=\"note\">Left and right arrow keys also move between stages.</span>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n</div>\n</section>\n\n<section id=\"evidence\" aria-labelledby=\"h-evidence\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-evidence\">Explore the evidence</h2>\n\n  <h3>Which early signals survive held-out validation?</h3>\n  <p class=\"q\">Ten indicators were chosen on the development set and scored once on four held-out field groups and two cohort splits. Pick a unit to see whether each indicator's partial Spearman with breadth holds there.</p>\n  <div class=\"card\">\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <div><label class=\"lab\" for=\"f-unit\">Unit</label>\n        <select id=\"f-unit\"></select></div>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-screen\"><svg id=\"s-screen\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Indicator screen forest plot\"></svg><div class=\"tip\" role=\"status\"></div></div>\n    <ul class=\"legend\">\n      <li><span class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></span>Confirmed on held-out (Holm p &lt; 0.05, CI excludes zero)</li>\n      <li><span class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--muted)\"></span>Not confirmed</li>\n    </ul>\n    <p class=\"take\" id=\"t-screen\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    <h4>Do the indicators add forecasting power over the baseline?</h4>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-learned\"><svg id=\"s-learned\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Bar chart of Spearman with breadth for baseline and learned models\"></svg><div class=\"tip\" role=\"status\"></div></div>\n    <p class=\"take\" id=\"t-learned\"></p>\n  </div>\n\n  <h3>What does openness look like for a single concept?</h3>\n  <p class=\"q\">The fresh 2015–2017 cohort was never used to choose the index. Each record below holds a concept's early inputs, a frozen B5-only forecast of its breadth, a frozen B5 + OPEN<sub>home</sub> forecast, and the breadth it actually reached. Filter, search and sort, then select a concept.</p>\n  <div class=\"card\">\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <div><label class=\"lab\" for=\"b-search\">Search concepts</label><input type=\"search\" id=\"b-search\" placeholder=\"e.g. homology\"></div>\n      <div><label class=\"lab\" for=\"b-group\">Home group</label><select id=\"b-group\"></select></div>\n      <div><label class=\"lab\" for=\"b-scope\">Records</label><select id=\"b-scope\">\n        <option value=\"full\">With outcome and both forecasts</option>\n        <option value=\"obs\">With observed breadth</option>\n        <option value=\"all\">All cohort concepts</option></select></div>\n      <div><label class=\"lab\" for=\"b-sort\">Sort by</label><select id=\"b-sort\">\n        <option value=\"open\">OPEN<sub>home</sub>, high to low</option>\n        <option value=\"excess\">Breadth beyond B5 forecast</option>\n        <option value=\"obs\">Observed breadth</option>\n        <option value=\"name\">Name</option></select></div>\n      <label class=\"chk\"><input type=\"checkbox\" id=\"b-worse\"> Only where OPEN moved the forecast away from the observed value</label>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"stats\" id=\"b-stats\" aria-live=\"polite\"></div>\n    <div class=\"browser\">\n      <div>\n        <p class=\"note\" id=\"b-count\" style=\"margin:0 0 6px\"></p>\n        <ul class=\"clist\" id=\"b-list\" aria-label=\"Concepts\"></ul>\n        <button class=\"btn\" id=\"b-more\" type=\"button\" style=\"margin-top:8px\">Show 50 more</button>\n      </div>\n      <div>\n        <div id=\"b-detail\"></div>\n        <h4>All concepts in view: openness against breadth beyond the B5 forecast</h4>\n        <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-scatter\"><svg id=\"s-scatter\" tabindex=\"0\" role=\"img\" aria-label=\"Scatter plot. Use left and right arrow keys to move between concepts.\"></svg><div class=\"tip\" role=\"status\"></div></div>\n        <ul class=\"legend\"><li><span class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--accent);border-radius:7px\"></span>Concept in view</li><li><span class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--warn);border-radius:7px\"></span>Selected concept</li><li><span class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--muted);height:2px\"></span>Zero: breadth exactly as B5 forecast</li></ul>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"take\" id=\"t-browser\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    <p class=\"note\">Spearman values in the tiles are computed live over the concepts in view. With no filter they reproduce the recorded 0.768 (B5) and 0.770 (B5 + OPEN<sub>home</sub>) on 573 concepts.</p>\n  </div>\n</div>\n</section>\n\n<section id=\"try\" aria-labelledby=\"h-try\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-try\">Try it</h2>\n  <h3>Compute OPEN yourself</h3>\n  <p class=\"q\">OPEN is simple enough to run here: each component is <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"z\">z-scored</button> with constants frozen on the 12,499-concept frame, signed, and averaged. Pick a concept from the seven matched case pairs, choose a build, and switch components off to see what carries the score.</p>\n  <div class=\"card\">\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <div><label class=\"lab\" for=\"o-concept\">Concept</label><select id=\"o-concept\"></select></div>\n      <fieldset><legend>Build</legend><div class=\"seg\" id=\"o-build\">\n        <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"build\" value=\"home\" checked><span>Home only</span></label>\n        <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"build\" value=\"all\"><span>All papers</span></label>\n        <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"build\" value=\"size\"><span>Size-matched</span></label></div></fieldset>\n    </div>\n    <fieldset><legend>Components included</legend><div class=\"controls\" id=\"o-comps\"></div></fieldset>\n    <div class=\"tscroll\"><table id=\"o-table\"></table></div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-open\"><svg id=\"s-open\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Signed z-score of each OPEN component\"></svg><div class=\"tip\" role=\"status\"></div></div>\n    <p class=\"take\" id=\"t-open\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n\n  <h3>What if we split the cohort at an openness threshold?</h3>\n  <p class=\"q\">Move the threshold over the recorded OPEN<sub>home</sub> scores of the 573 cohort concepts that have both forecasts and an outcome. The chart recomputes how far concepts on each side landed from their B5 forecast.</p>\n  <div class=\"card\">\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <div><label class=\"lab\" for=\"w-pct\">Threshold percentile of OPEN<sub>home</sub>: <output id=\"w-out\" for=\"w-pct\"></output></label>\n      <input type=\"range\" id=\"w-pct\" min=\"10\" max=\"90\" step=\"5\" value=\"50\"></div>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-whatif\"><svg id=\"s-whatif\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Mean breadth beyond B5 forecast above and below the threshold\"></svg><div class=\"tip\" role=\"status\"></div></div>\n    <p class=\"take\" id=\"t-whatif\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    <p class=\"note\">Breadth beyond forecast = observed O<sub>2r</sub> (m = 50) minus the frozen B5-only forecast, in venue fields. This is a descriptive split of recorded values, not the paper's partial Spearman.</p>\n  </div>\n</div>\n</section>\n\n<section id=\"fails\" aria-labelledby=\"h-fails\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-fails\">Where it fails</h2>\n  <p class=\"q\">Three places where the evidence stops short: the churn signal under noise controls, the retained-frontier entry model, and individual concepts that openness mis-forecasts.</p>\n  <div class=\"card\">\n    <div role=\"tablist\" aria-label=\"Failure views\" id=\"fail-tabs\">\n      <button role=\"tab\" id=\"tab-noise\" aria-controls=\"p-noise\" aria-selected=\"true\">Churn under noise controls</button>\n      <button role=\"tab\" id=\"tab-entry\" aria-controls=\"p-entry\" aria-selected=\"false\" tabindex=\"-1\">Retained-frontier entry</button>\n      <button role=\"tab\" id=\"tab-miss\" aria-controls=\"p-miss\" aria-selected=\"false\" tabindex=\"-1\">Mis-forecast concepts</button>\n    </div>\n    <div role=\"tabpanel\" id=\"p-noise\" aria-labelledby=\"tab-noise\">\n      <p class=\"prose\">Is the <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"novchurn\">NOVCHURN</button> signal real turnover, or an artefact of thin yearly samples? Each row re-scores the pooled association after one noise control.</p>\n      <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-noise\"><svg id=\"s-noise\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Partial Spearman of NOVCHURN variants\"></svg><div class=\"tip\" role=\"status\"></div></div>\n      <p class=\"take\" id=\"t-noise\"></p>\n    </div>\n    <div role=\"tabpanel\" id=\"p-entry\" aria-labelledby=\"tab-entry\" hidden>\n      <p class=\"prose\">Do concepts enter next the fields related to the ones that <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"retain\">currently retain</button> them? The <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"d0\">retained-frontier coefficient d<sub>0</sub></button> is positive, but switch on the checks the pre-registration required.</p>\n      <label class=\"chk\"><input type=\"checkbox\" id=\"e-checks\"> Show the specificity checks that failed</label>\n      <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-entry\"><svg id=\"s-entry\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Retained-frontier coefficient by unit\"></svg><div class=\"tip\" role=\"status\"></div></div>\n      <p class=\"take\" id=\"t-entry\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    </div>\n    <div role=\"tabpanel\" id=\"p-miss\" aria-labelledby=\"tab-miss\" hidden>\n      <p class=\"prose\" id=\"miss-text\"></p>\n      <button class=\"btn\" id=\"miss-go\" type=\"button\">Show these concepts in the browser</button>\n      <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-miss\"><svg id=\"s-miss\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Distribution of forecast change from adding OPEN\"></svg><div class=\"tip\" role=\"status\"></div></div>\n      <p class=\"take\" id=\"t-miss\"></p>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n  <h3>What the paper does not show</h3>\n  <ul class=\"limits prose\">\n    <li><strong>No forecasting gain.</strong> OPEN<sub>home</sub> adds no forecasting gain over B5 (+0.002 [−0.003, +0.008]). The association is modest.</li>\n    <li><strong>Not causal.</strong> Early openness could reflect a concept's intrinsic generality, the diversity of the research community around it, or the breadth of the problems it addresses. A within-concept closure test is null on DEV and opposite-signed on held-out fields (−0.079), so openness behaves as a between-concept trait.</li>\n    <li><strong>Temporal turnover is untested, not refuted.</strong> The temporal-excess variants have split-half reliability below 0.05, so static dispersion and temporal churn cannot be separated at about 10 home papers per year.</li>\n    <li><strong>Mechanical coupling.</strong> About half of the OPEN<sub>all</sub> signal is coupling between off-home papers in the ego network and the breadth outcome. OPEN<sub>home</sub> is free of it but marginal: on the fresh cohort its DerSimonian–Laird interval includes zero (+0.083 [−0.007, +0.173]).</li>\n    <li><strong>Prior unsealing.</strong> Held-out outcomes were read by earlier experiments in the same project, so the pool is descriptive rather than confirmatory. Only the 2015–2017 cohort was never used before.</li>\n    <li><strong>Vocabulary bias.</strong> The legacy concept vocabulary is survivor-selected; the vocabulary-free frame is small (636 concepts, pre-unseal power 0.47) and its verdict is partial.</li>\n    <li><strong>Retained-frontier entry is PARTIAL.</strong> Persistence and volume stay confounded, and the effect is specific to the PMI backbone.</li>\n  </ul>\n</div>\n</section>\n</main>\n\n<footer id=\"notes\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <h2>Links, data and glossary</h2>\n  <div class=\"links\" style=\"margin-bottom:24px\">\n    <a class=\"btn primary\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8795ea-concepts-spread-once-adopters-make-them@fork/run_MjdbXJqg-rPl/paper.pdf\">Read the paper (PDF)</a>\n    <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8795ea-concepts-spread-once-adopters-make-them@fork/run_MjdbXJqg-rPl/report.pdf\">Read the full research report</a>\n    <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8795ea-concepts-spread-once-adopters-make-them/tree/fork/run_MjdbXJqg-rPl\">Code repository</a>\n  </div>\n  <h3>Data provenance</h3>\n  <p class=\"note\">Every chart, count and table on this page is built in the browser from JSON embedded in the page, extracted by script from these run outputs.</p>\n  <ul class=\"prov\" id=\"prov\"></ul>\n  <h3>Glossary</h3>\n  <dl class=\"gloss\" id=\"gloss\"></dl>\n</div>\n</footer>\n<div id=\"termtip\" role=\"tooltip\"></div>\n\n<script type=\"application/json\" id=\"data-synthesis\" data-source=\"evaluation_4/results/evidence_synthesis.json\">__DATA_synthesis__</script>\n<script type=\"application/json\" id=\"data-screen\" data-source=\"experiment_8/results/heldout_summary.json; experiment_8/results/learned_vs_single_heldout.json\">__DATA_screen__</script>\n<script type=\"application/json\" id=\"data-cohort\" data-source=\"experiment_10/full_method_out.json; experiment_10/results/cohort_result.json\">__DATA_cohort__</script>\n<script type=\"application/json\" id=\"data-cases\" data-source=\"experiment_12/results/case_pairs.json; experiment_12/case_studies/*/pair.json; experiment_12/results/frozen_spec.json\">__DATA_cases__</script>\n<script type=\"application/json\" id=\"data-entry\" data-source=\"experiment_7/results/frontier_result.json\">__DATA_entry__</script>\n<script type=\"application/json\" id=\"data-noise\" data-source=\"experiment_16/results/clean_vs_raw_psp.json\">__DATA_noise__</script>\n<script>\n\"use strict\";\n(function(){\nconst get = id => JSON.parse(document.getElementById(id).textContent).data;\nconst SYN = get('data-synthesis'), SCR = get('data-screen'), COH = get('data-cohort'),\n      CASES = get('data-cases'), ENTRY = get('data-entry'), NOISE = get('data-noise');\nconst $ = s => document.querySelector(s);\nconst NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';\nconst MINUS = '−';\nconst reduceMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;\nfunction el(tag, attrs, parent){ const e = document.createElementNS(NS, tag); if (attrs) for (const k in attrs) e.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]); if (parent) parent.appendChild(e); return e; }\nfunction txt(parent, x, y, s, attrs){ const t = el('text', Object.assign({x: x, y: y}, attrs || {}), parent); t.textContent = s; return t; }\nfunction f(x, d, sign){ if (d === undefined) d = 3; if (sign === undefined) sign = true; if (x === null || x === undefined || isNaN(x)) return 'n/a';\n  const s = Math.abs(x).toFixed(d); if (Number(s) === 0) return s; return (x < 0 ? MINUS : (sign ? '+' : '')) + s; }\nfunction fci(a, d, sign){ return '[' + f(a[0], d, sign) + ', ' + f(a[1], d, sign) + ']'; }\nfunction esc(s){ return String(s).replace(/[&<>\"]/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','\"':'&quot;'}[c])); }\nconst CSSV = n => getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(n).trim();\nconst C = { accent: CSSV('--accent'), muted: CSSV('--muted'), mutedSoft: CSSV('--muted-soft'), ink: CSSV('--ink'), ink2: CSSV('--ink2'), grid: CSSV('--grid'), rule: CSSV('--rule'), warn: CSSV('--warn') };\n// text measurement\nconst mSvg = el('svg', {width: 0, height: 0, style: 'position:absolute;left:-9999px;top:0;visibility:hidden'}); document.body.appendChild(mSvg);\nconst mText = el('text', {x: 0, y: 0, style: 'font-family:' + CSSV('--font')}, mSvg);\nfunction measure(s, fs, weight){ mText.setAttribute('font-size', fs); mText.setAttribute('font-weight', weight || 400); mText.textContent = s; return mText.getComputedTextLength(); }\nfunction niceTicks(lo, hi, n){ const span = hi - lo; const step0 = span / Math.max(1, n); const mag = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(step0))); const e = step0 / mag;\n  const step = (e >= 7.5 ? 10 : e >= 3.5 ? 5 : e >= 1.5 ? 2 : 1) * mag; const out = [];\n  for (let v = Math.ceil(lo / step - 1e-9) * step; v <= hi + 1e-9; v += step) out.push(Number(v.toFixed(10))); return out; }\nfunction tickFmt(v, step){ const d = step >= 1 ? 0 : step >= 0.1 ? 1 : step >= 0.01 ? 2 : 3; return f(v, d, false); }\n\n// shared chart tooltip behaviour\nfunction bindMark(g, chartDiv, html){\n  const tip = chartDiv.querySelector('.tip');\n  const show = () => { chartDiv.querySelectorAll('.mark.hot').forEach(m => m.classList.remove('hot')); g.classList.add('hot'); tip.innerHTML = html; tip.style.display = 'block';\n    const cb = chartDiv.getBoundingClientRect(), gb = g.getBoundingClientRect();\n    let left = gb.left - cb.left + gb.width / 2 - tip.offsetWidth / 2; left = Math.max(0, Math.min(left, cb.width - tip.offsetWidth));\n    let top = gb.top - cb.top - tip.offsetHeight - 8; if (top < 0) top = gb.bottom - cb.top + 8; tip.style.left = left + 'px'; tip.style.top = top + 'px'; };\n  const hide = () => { g.classList.remove('hot'); tip.style.display = 'none'; };\n  g.addEventListener('mouseenter', show); g.addEventListener('focus', show); g.addEventListener('click', e => { e.stopPropagation(); show(); });\n  g.addEventListener('mouseleave', hide); g.addEventListener('blur', hide);\n}\ndocument.addEventListener('click', () => { document.querySelectorAll('.chart .tip').forEach(t => { t.style.display = 'none'; }); document.querySelectorAll('.mark.hot').forEach(m => m.classList.remove('hot')); });\n\n/* ---------- generic forest plot ---------- */\nfunction forest(svgId, rows, o){\n  const svg = document.getElementById(svgId), div = svg.parentNode; svg.innerHTML = '';\n  const W = Math.max(280, div.clientWidth); const fs = W < 480 ? 12 : 13;\n  const labelW = Math.max.apply(null, rows.map(r => measure(r.label, fs, r.bold ? 700 : 400))) + 8;\n  const showVals = W >= 600;\n  const valTexts = rows.map(r => showVals ? r.valueText : r.shortText);\n  const valW = Math.max.apply(null, valTexts.map(t => measure(t, fs))) + 12;\n  const rowH = 30, top = 8, bottom = 46;\n  const sepIdx = rows.findIndex(r => r.sep);\n  const H = top + rows.length * rowH + (sepIdx >= 0 ? 10 : 0) + bottom;\n  svg.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 ' + W + ' ' + H); svg.setAttribute('height', H);\n  const x0 = labelW + 10, x1 = W - valW - 8;\n  let lo = Math.min(0, ...rows.map(r => (r.lo ?? r.est)), ...(rows.map(r => r.band ? -r.band : 0)));\n  let hi = Math.max(0, ...rows.map(r => (r.hi ?? r.est)), ...(rows.map(r => r.band ? r.band : 0)));\n  if (o.domain){ lo = Math.min(lo, o.domain[0]); hi = Math.max(hi, o.domain[1]); }\n  const pad = (hi - lo) * 0.04; lo -= pad; hi += pad;\n  const X = v => x0 + (v - lo) / (hi - lo) * (x1 - x0);\n  const plotBottom = H - bottom;\n  const nT = Math.max(2, Math.floor((x1 - x0) / 70)); const tk = niceTicks(lo, hi, nT); const step = tk.length > 1 ? tk[1] - tk[0] : 1;\n  const gGrid = el('g', {}, svg);\n  tk.forEach(t => { el('line', {x1: X(t), x2: X(t), y1: top, y2: plotBottom, stroke: C.grid}, gGrid);\n    txt(gGrid, X(t), plotBottom + 16, tickFmt(t, step), {'text-anchor': 'middle', 'font-size': fs - 1}); });\n  el('line', {x1: X(0), x2: X(0), y1: top, y2: plotBottom, stroke: C.ink2, 'stroke-dasharray': '4 3'}, svg);\n  if (o.refLine !== undefined && o.refLine !== null) el('line', {x1: X(o.refLine), x2: X(o.refLine), y1: top, y2: plotBottom, stroke: '#111', 'stroke-dasharray': '1 3', 'stroke-width': 1.5}, svg);\n  txt(svg, (x0 + x1) / 2, H - 6, o.xTitle, {'text-anchor': 'middle', 'font-size': fs, 'font-weight': 600});\n  const div2 = div;\n  let y = top;\n  rows.forEach((r, i) => {\n    if (r.sep){ y += 10; el('line', {x1: 0, x2: W, y1: y - 5, y2: y - 5, stroke: C.rule}, svg); }\n    const cy = y + rowH / 2;\n    const g = el('g', {class: 'mark', tabindex: 0, role: 'img', 'aria-label': r.aria || (r.label + ': ' + r.valueText)}, svg);\n    el('rect', {class: 'hit', x: 0, y: y + 1, width: W, height: rowH - 2, fill: 'transparent', rx: 4}, g);\n    if (r.band) el('rect', {x: X(-r.band), width: X(r.band) - X(-r.band), y: y + 6, height: rowH - 12, fill: C.mutedSoft, stroke: C.rule}, g);\n    txt(g, labelW, cy + 4, r.label, {'text-anchor': 'end', 'font-size': fs, 'font-weight': r.bold ? 700 : 400, fill: r.dim ? C.muted : C.ink});\n    const col = r.color || C.accent;\n    if (r.lo !== undefined && r.lo !== null){\n      if (r.shape === 'diamond'){\n        el('polygon', {points: [X(r.lo) + ',' + cy, X(r.est) + ',' + (cy - 8), X(r.hi) + ',' + cy, X(r.est) + ',' + (cy + 8)].join(' '), fill: '#111'}, g);\n      } else {\n        el('line', {x1: X(r.lo), x2: X(r.hi), y1: cy, y2: cy, stroke: col, 'stroke-width': 2}, g);\n        el('line', {x1: X(r.lo), x2: X(r.lo), y1: cy - 5, y2: cy + 5, stroke: col, 'stroke-width': 2}, g);\n        el('line', {x1: X(r.hi), x2: X(r.hi), y1: cy - 5, y2: cy + 5, stroke: col, 'stroke-width': 2}, g);\n      }\n    }\n    if (r.shape !== 'diamond') el(r.shape === 'circle' ? 'circle' : 'rect', r.shape === 'circle' ? {cx: X(r.est), cy: cy, r: 5.5, fill: col} : {x: X(r.est) - 5.5, y: cy - 5.5, width: 11, height: 11, fill: col}, g);\n    txt(g, W - valW + 6, cy + 4, valTexts[i], {'font-size': fs, fill: r.dim ? C.muted : C.ink2, 'font-weight': r.bold ? 700 : 400});\n    bindMark(g, div2, r.tip);\n    y += rowH;\n  });\n}\n\n/* ---------- generic horizontal bar chart (bars start at zero) ---------- */\nfunction hbars(svgId, cats, series, o){\n  const svg = document.getElementById(svgId), div = svg.parentNode; svg.innerHTML = '';\n  const W = Math.max(280, div.clientWidth); const fs = W < 480 ? 12 : 13;\n  const labelW = Math.max.apply(null, cats.map(c => measure(c.label, fs))) + 8;\n  const barH = series.length > 1 ? 14 : 20, gap = 3, groupH = series.length * (barH + gap) + 12;\n  const top = 6, bottom = 44; const H = top + cats.length * groupH + bottom;\n  svg.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 ' + W + ' ' + H); svg.setAttribute('height', H);\n  const vals = []; cats.forEach(c => series.forEach(s => vals.push(c.values[s.key])));\n  const vt = cats.map(c => series.map(s => (o.fmt || (v => f(v)))(c.values[s.key])));\n  const maxLab = Math.max.apply(null, vt.flat().map(t => measure(t, fs - 1))) + 8;\n  let lo = Math.min(0, ...vals), hi = Math.max(0, ...vals); if (o.domain){ lo = Math.min(lo, o.domain[0]); hi = Math.max(hi, o.domain[1]); }\n  const x0 = labelW + 10 + (lo < 0 ?         pg.click("#f-feat label:nth-child(1) span"); pg.click("#f-rung label:nth-child(2) span"); pg.click("#f-dev"); pg.click("#f-plac")
        # hover a mark
        pg.locator("#s-forest .mark").nth(0).hover(); pg.wait_for_timeout(100)
        res["forest_tip"] = pg.inner_text("#c-forest .tip")
        pg.locator("#c-forest").screenshot(path=str(SHOTS / f"{tag}_forest_hover.png"))
        # term tooltip: click and confirm stays

        res["term_text"] = pg.inner_text("#termtip")[:60]
        pg.screenshot(path=str(SHOTS / f"{tag}_term.png"))
        pg.keyboard.press("Escape"); res["term_after_esc"] = pg.evaluate("getComputedStyle(document.getElementById('termtip')).display")
        # stepper
        pg.locator("#stepper").scroll_into_view_if_needed()
        steps = []
        for i in range(6):
            steps.append(pg.inner_text("#step-live"))
            pg.locator("#stepper").screenshot(path=str(SHOTS / f"{tag}_step{i+1}.png"))
            if i < 5: pg.click("#step-next")
        res["steps"] = steps
        res["next_disabled_end"] = pg.is_disabled("#step-next")
        pg.focus("#step-prev"); pg.keyboard.press("ArrowLeft"); res["after_left"] = pg.inner_text("#step-live")

        # screen
        pg.select_option("#f-unit", "LIFEENV"); res["take_screen"] = pg.inner_text("#t-screen")
        pg.locator("#c-screen").screenshot(path=str(SHOTS / f"{tag}_screen.png"))
        pg.select_option("#f-unit", "POOLED"); res["take_screen_pooled"] = pg.inner_text("#t-screen")
        # browser

        res["take_browser"] = pg.inner_text("#t-browser")
        pg.fill("#b-search", "homology"); pg.wait_for_timeout(100); res["count_search"] = pg.inner_text("#b-count")
        pg.fill("#b-search", ""); pg.select_option("#b-group", "SOC"); res["stats_soc"] = pg.inner_text("#b-stats")
        pg.locator("#b-list button").nth(2).click(); res["detail"] = pg.inner_text("#b-detail")[:300]
        pg.locator("#evidence .card").nth(1).screenshot(path=str(SHOTS / f"{tag}_browser.png"))
        pg.select_option("#b-sort", "excess"); pg.check("#b-worse"); res["count_worse"] = pg.inner_text("#b-count")
        pg.uncheck("#b-worse"); pg.select_option("#b-group", "all"); pg.select_option("#b-sort", "open")

        pg.keyboard.press("Enter"); res["sel_after_enter"] = pg.inner_text("#b-detail")[:60]

        pg.locator("#o-comps input").nth(0).uncheck(); res["take_open_drop"] = pg.inner_text("#t-open")

        pg.locator("#try .card").nth(0).screenshot(path=str(SHOTS / f"{tag}_open.png"))
        for i in range(3): pg.locator("#o-comps input").nth(i).check()
        pg.fill("#w-pct", "80"); pg.dispatch_event("#w-pct", "input"); res["take_whatif"] = pg.inner_text("#t-whatif")
        pg.locator("#try .card").nth(1).screenshot(path=str(SHOTS / f"{tag}_whatif.png"))
        # fails
        res["take_noise"] = pg.inner_text("#t-noise")
        pg.locator("#fails .card").screenshot(path=str(SHOTS / f"{tag}_noise.png"))
        pg.click("#tab-entry"); res["take_entry"] = pg.inner_text("#t-entry")
        pg.click("#e-checks"); res["take_entry_chk"] = pg.inner_text("#t-entry")
        pg.locator("#fails .card").screenshot(path=str(SHOTS / f"{tag}_entry.png"))
        pg.click("#tab-miss"); res["miss"] = pg.inner_text("#miss-text") + " || " + pg.inner_text("#t-miss")
        pg.locator("#fails .card").screenshot(path=str(SHOTS / f"{tag}_miss.png"))
        pg.click("#miss-go"); pg.wait_for_timeout(600); res["after_go"] = pg.inner_text("#b-count")
        res["overlaps_end"] = pg.evaluate(OVERLAP_JS)
        res["hscroll_end"] = pg.evaluate("document.documentElement.scrollWidth > window.innerWidth")
        pg.screenshot(path=str(SHOTS / f"{tag}_full.png"), full_page=True)
        b.close()
    res["console"] = msgs
    return res

for w in [int(a) for a in sys.argv[1:]] or [390, 1440]:

href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8795ea-concepts-spread-once-adopters-make-them@fork/run_MjdbXJqg-rPl/round-3/report.pdf\">Round 3</a>,\n481:    <a href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8795ea-concepts-spread-once-adopters-make-them@fork/run_MjdbXJqg-rPl/round-4/report.pdf\">Round 4</a>,\n482:    <a href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8795ea-concepts-spread-once-adopters-make-them@fork/run_MjdbXJqg-rPl/round-5/report.pdf\">Round 5</a>\n554:  <p>Seven of the 53 screened indicators survive held-out validation with Holm correction. These span two families: retained frontier (end-of-window field density, volume-weighted field density, contact reach, retention ratio) and co-occurrence topology (community count, novel-partner share, ego density). Two confirmed indicators carry negative signs: the early retention ratio (&minus;0.114, concepts with higher early field retention spread less broadly) and ego density (&minus;0.102, denser local neighbourhoods go with narrower spread). <a class=\"code-link\" href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8795ea-concepts-spread-once-adopters-make-them/tree/fork/run_MjdbXJqg-rPl/round-3/experiment-8\">Code: indicator screen</a></p>\n561:    <p class=\"detail\">The home-field OPEN index (OPEN<sub>home</sub>), pooled across six non-selection bodies (four held-out domain groups plus the 2010&ndash;2014 and 2015&ndash;2017 cohorts) by DerSimonian&ndash;Laird, gives partial Spearman +0.069 [+0.038, +0.100] with I&sup2; = 0, all six bodies positive. The development-set estimate (+0.109) shows 1.58&times; shrinkage relative to the non-selection pool. The association is small and has the same sign in every body, but only the two cohort rows and the pool have confidence intervals above zero individually. <a class=\"code-link\" href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8795ea-concepts-spread-once-adopters-make-them/tree/fork/run_MjdbXJqg-rPl/round-5/evaluation-4\">Code: evidence pool</a></p>\n564:  <p>The OPEN index was tested on a 2015&ndash;2017 onset cohort (1,443 concepts) never used in any prior screen. OPEN<sub>home</sub> passes the primary concept-type rung (R2: PSP = +0.091, 95% CI [+0.013, +0.171], Holm p = 0.048), but its DerSimonian&ndash;Laird pooled interval includes zero (+0.083 [&minus;0.007, +0.173]), making the home-only signal marginal. <a class=\"code-link\" href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8795ea-concepts-spread-once-adopters-make-them/tree/fork/run_MjdbXJqg-rPl/round-4/experiment-10\">Code: cohort test</a></p>\n569:  <p>Cheng et al.'s ideational consistency, rebuilt on OpenAlex topic co-usage for 12,311 concepts, reproduces their estimate for volume: b = 0.428 (+53.5%/SD). Adding current volume removes almost all of it: +1.3% [+0.5%, +2.1%]. Net of the popularity baseline, the partial Spearman of consistency with rarefied breadth is &minus;0.069 [&minus;0.093, &minus;0.047] on the pooled bodies (I&sup2; = 0, 5/5 groups negative), replicating on the 2015&ndash;2017 cohort (&minus;0.111). The consistency measure has Spearman +0.77 with edge persistence: it is weighted persistence. A stable neighbourhood goes with growth mainly because it goes with current size. <a class=\"code-link\" href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8795ea-concepts-spread-once-adopters-make-them/tree/fork/run_MjdbXJqg-rPl/round-5/experiment-14\">Code: consistency analysis</a></p>\n578:    <p class=\"detail\">On an independent frame of 11,841 concepts (6,978 entry events), the retained-frontier coefficient is d<sub>0</sub> = 0.322 [0.291, 0.355]: the log-odds of entering a field per SD of relatedness to the off-home fields that currently retain the concept. The result is positive in all three evaluable held-out groups: Physical Sciences 0.148, Life &amp; Environment 0.401, Social Sciences 0.297. Mathematics &amp; Decision Sciences (n = 165) is null (0.065 [&minus;0.110, 0.234]). The DerSimonian&ndash;Laird pooled estimate is 0.243 [0.118, 0.368] with high heterogeneity (I&sup2; = 0.92). <a class=\"code-link\" href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8795ea-concepts-spread-once-adopters-make-them/tree/fork/run_MjdbXJqg-rPl/round-3/experiment-7\">Code: entry model</a></p>\n584:  <p>On 3,188 DEV concepts, the breadth gap between the top and bottom rarefied-breadth terciles decomposes as: early contact diversity 77.9%, frontier advance &minus;4.6%, retention 26.8% (unstratified). The primary volume-stratified variant gives 76.0% / &minus;4.5% / 28.5%. Exploration minus retention is 0.464 [0.407, 0.528]. Early contact diversity accounts for most of the breadth gap; frontier advance contributes almost nothing. These shares are an accounting identity, not causal effects. <a class=\"code-link\" href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8795ea-concepts-spread-once-adopters-make-them/tree/fork/run_MjdbXJqg-rPl/round-4/experiment-12\">Code: decomposition</a></p>\n587:  <p>The within-concept permutation null absorbs year-to-year churn: the excess NOVCHURN pooled partial Spearman is +0.008 [&minus;0.02, +0.03], compared to raw +0.116 [+0.09, +0.14]. What predicts breadth is a static property of the concept's home-topic partner mix, not temporal turnover. Split-half reliability of NOVCHURN is 0.48; the temporal-excess variants have reliability below 0.05, so temporal versus static dispersion cannot be resolved at available sample sizes. <a class=\"code-link\" href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8795ea-concepts-spread-once-adopters-make-them/tree/fork/run_MjdbXJqg-rPl/round-5/experiment-16\">Code: confound tests</a></p>\n589:  <p>A within-concept closure test is null on the development set (density PPML b = &minus;0.070 [&minus;0.180, 0.040]; OPEN<sub>home</sub> b = +0.015 [&minus;0.038, 0.069]). On held-out fields, OPEN<sub>home</sub> is opposite-signed (&minus;0.079 [&minus;0.146, &minus;0.013]). Early openness is a between-concept trait, not a within-concept mechanism. <a class=\"code-link\" href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8795ea-concepts-spread-once-adopters-make-them/tree/fork/run_MjdbXJqg-rPl/round-5/experiment-15\">Code: closure test</a></p>\n591:  <p>Vocabulary-free replication on 636 phrase-born concepts gives OPEN<sub>home</sub> PSP +0.117 [+0.020, +0.218] at control rung R3, partial confirmation. The signal is carried by neighbourhood novelty (NOV<sub>res</sub> +0.208 [+0.113, +0.303]). <a class=\"code-link\" href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8795ea-concepts-spread-once-adopters-make-them/tree/fork/run_MjdbXJqg-rPl/round-5/experiment-13\">Code: vocabulary-free test</a></p>\n656:    <a href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8795ea-concepts-spread-once-adopters-make-them/tree/fork/run_MjdbXJqg-rPl/round-1/experiment-1\">Code: Does citing a concept 'as your own' predict its spread?</a>\n657:    <a href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8795ea-concepts-spread-once-adopters-make-them/tree/fork/run_MjdbXJqg-rPl/round-1/experiment-3\">Code: Do diverse topic ties predict concept spread?</a>\n658:    <a href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8795ea-concepts-spread-once-adopters-make-them/tree/fork/run_MjdbXJqg-rPl/round-1/experiment-4\">Code: Where a concept lands early vs how broadly it spreads</a>\n659:    <a href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8795ea-concepts-spread-once-adopters-make-them/tree/fork/run_MjdbXJqg-rPl/round-2/experiment-5\">Code: Do hub fields keep new concepts?
